quote.text: Of all people only those are at leisure who make time for philosophy, only those are really alive. For they not only keep a good watch over their own lifetimes, but they annex every age to theirs. All the years that have passed before them are added to their own. Unless we are very ungrateful, all those distinguished founders of holy creeds were born for us and prepared for us a way of life.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Philosophy, as Seneca implies, teaches us the value of a reflective life—one where parents consciously invest time to nurture not only their children’s growth but also their own inner development.
    • By making time for thoughtful reflection, parents can better pass on enduring wisdom and exemplify a life lived with intention, ensuring that the legacy they leave is as rich and instructive as the teachings of past sages.
  • Leadership
    • An effective leader recognizes that time is both a precious resource and a bridge between past insights and future innovations; embracing philosophy can provide a foundation for principled decision-making.
    • Leaders who integrate reflective practices into their routine not only honor the legacy of great thinkers but also inspire their teams to engage in a thoughtful, purpose-driven pursuit of excellence.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, the concept of annexing every age to one’s own reminds us that great products are built on the cumulative wisdom of previous experiences, market insights, and customer feedback.
    • By dedicating time to philosophical reflection, product managers can foster creativity and strategic vision, ensuring that every decision is enriched by lessons learned from both history and everyday life.
